result.reason: The clause gives Company the requested affiliate and transaction-related assignment carve-out and leaves Contractor assignments subject to Company consent not unreasonably withheld, but it does not prohibit assignment by Contractor to a Company competitor. It also does not meet the fallback because Contractor receives no notice-only right to assign to a successor. The added subcontractor-responsibility language is outside the assignment/change-of-control position and changes unrelated risk allocation, so the revision is broader than necessary. The drafting is otherwise generally clear, though the carve-out for partial assignments and business-unit transactions is broader than the preferred position.
